description: Accepted historical dependency-audit findings. Each entry must name the advisory ID, the package, a reason, and a review_by date (YYYY-MM-DD). The gate blocks any new finding not listed here, and blocks an entry whose review_by date has passed while its finding still exists. See docs/ci-security.md.
